Definition: from the base of G3674 and G5078; a fellow-artificer:--of the same craft.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, homótechnos means of the same craft. It occurs just once, in Acts.
TheologicalSignificance: I take homótechnos as it stands — of the same craft — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
